prep: no prep/ directory and no prep.done for this slug; plan, audits and comparator reading built by the writer
setting: Text entry by spelling, any signal type in the wiki; one population (full-text speller pattern, 483 unique studies, 252 dated 2022 or earlier excluding the target) for all four topics; acoustic-only systems outside the wiki.

inherited.M01: Cued silent attempts of isolated code words and sentences; 10-model ensemble; Moses 2021 lineage
inherited.M03: Preceding-session data, no day-of recalibration; zero-error sentence trials added
inherited.M05: 128-channel ECoG over sensorimotor cortex, HGA + LFS (Moses 2021 lineage)
inherited.M06: Speech detector plus GRU code-word classifier (Moses 2021 lineage)
inherited.M08: 26 letters, spaces inserted by the beam search
inherited.M10: No user editing; LM may revise earlier words
inherited.M11: Prompted sentences; conversational intent confirmed by nod or AAC device
inherited.M13: One participant, percutaneous connector, supervised use

topics.inclusion_rule: Setting (one definition for all four topics): text entry by spelling, in any signal type in the wiki (neural, EMG, EOG, EPG, video, ultrasound and others): studies whose full text, reference list removed, names a speller, letter-by-letter entry, or spelling out words, letters or sentences. Boundary: acoustic-only systems are outside the wiki; mentions in related work, reviews and unrelated uses of 'spelling' enter, so every count is an upper bound (pattern match); versions are counted once; the target's three versions are excluded; the usual approach is counted at the target's time (index year 2022 or earlier, target first public 2022-11). Design compared: the user action that selects each letter: evoked-potential speller (P300, SSVEP, RSVP), motor or cursor selection (point-and-click, virtual keyboard, motor imagery), attempted handwriting, NATO or radio-alphabet code words, other speech production of letters. A study counts under every action its text names.
topics.design_field: full-text regexes evoked_potential_speller, motor_or_cursor_selection, attempted_handwriting, nato_code_words, speech_letter_production
